name: After § 157
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 157 a. Ensure that under no circumstances, incurred of Union funding should use Union funding for detailed lobbying activities directed towards Union institutions, as the EU taxpayer should not be paying for interest related lobbying and as this can create reputational damage and risk upsetting the institutional balance in the Union; welcomed the Commissions new approach and new guidelines published in May 2024 to protect the EU budget; notes it is of course possible to express interests, but that the Union should not be paying for lobbying building capacity or direct lobbying of Union institutions or national and regional parliaments and governments, are not used for regional or national protect actions or lawsuits;
